The campaign reaches its end having spent more Western Allied lives than the historical record: the price of the bolder, more ██████████ road at several of this campaign's genuine forks. Market Garden's reach for Arnhem was scaled back before it happened rather than mourned after: Browning's private reservation taken seriously instead of █████████. Coalition Cohesion held solid across the war's hardest disagreements: the Western partnership that would anchor NATO within a few years was, on this path, unusually strong from the very █████. The Scheldt was ███████ before the autumn's offensives rather than after: Antwerp opened weeks early, and the ████████ █████ most postwar assessments rank █████ the campaign's costliest was simply not made. What was really being decided, choice by choice, was █████ whether Germany lost, only what the peace on the other side of it would look like.One Year LaterA year past victory in Europe, the machinery of occupation is running on the arrangements this campaign's own conferences (Tehran, █████, the ones this command actually attended) settled or failed to settle in advance.
